interpretation: The replay records the exact synthetic profiles and argv used by this local Seatbelt composition canary. It executes only /usr/bin/true and the harness opens no sockets. The child policy is a minimal network-service permission shape informed by Chromium network.sb, not Chromium’s exact generated profile. The outcomes can demonstrate this synthetic parent/child profile interaction only; they do not establish the sole cause of the separate packaged Electron failure or constitute UI/offline acceptance.
